description: Repairs r-str-ado-act/ado-edit: fixture state was not controlled (n6 was read back as ID 5 on a copy that may have been mutated) and Errors were read only once at the end. On a read-write ACE connection (own copy of r-fix-wire-ado-ado5) the stored rows of K (ID, Code, T) are read first; then a server keyset optimistic recordset on K: with Fields("T") retained read EditMode; set T = "edited" and read Value, OriginalValue, UnderlyingValue and EditMode before and after Update; set T = "moved" then MoveNext (EditMode after), MovePrevious and read T; set T = "cancel", CancelUpdate and read T; AddNew with Code = "n6", Update and read ID; Close; the stored rows of K are read again. Connection.Errors is read and cleared after each of these steps. Asks what each step reports and the generated ID.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
